title: Long-Tail Challenges in Electroluminescence-Based Photovoltaic Defect Detection: a Diagnostic Study
mechanism: Diagnoses that rare EL classes fail on localisation (predicted as background) and shows only cell-grid-aware copy-paste lifts tail AP.
adaptation: Paste inactive+crack pairs, splice, edge_dark, corrosion only onto labelled train cells at grid-consistent positions (between busbars, aligned with fingers, same source contrast), never onto unlabelled pool cells.
min_experiment: Arm: house + grid-aware rare-class paste. Baseline: house, 5 v 5 seeds. Metrics: test inactive IoU, mIoU_rob, splice / edge_dark IoU. Kill if inactive < +0.02 and mIoU_rob < +0.005.
evidence: R: 2,894 images, 61,331 instances, 14 classes, YOLOv11 mAP50 0.579; head AP 0.830 v tail 0.488; grid-aware paste ring_defect AP 0.145 to 0.288.
prior_overlap: Partial: crack copy-paste onto pool cells was n.d. (more decoys). Grid-aware paste on labelled cells for inactive and rare classes is untested.
